Alison — thanks for the clear asks and for sharing the checklist. We've reviewed and proposed a concise MAP layout that embeds the canary, migration, and training milestones so BlueHarbor can see the exact gating logic. Draft attached. Highlights here: 

- Canary window: proposed Jul 20 — Jul 31 (14 calendar days). Canary release day is Jul 20; 72-hour surge from Jul 27 in the event we need load validation.
- Eval criteria: token-level latency median < 180ms for 95% of requests, end-to-end SLA > 99.5% for the pilot, and no more than 1% PII handling regressions on sampled transcripts.
- Training: three live sessions (technical walk-through, moderation & monitoring, and admin onboarding) scheduled the week following canary close (Aug 3—Aug 7).

I attached JB_MPA_draft.pdf which converts your spreadsheet into our canonical MAP structure (owner, target date, gate, acceptance metric, rollback plan). If that looks good we'll produce a final MAP and an updated SOW for Legal.

Attachments: JB_MPA_draft.pdf

Next step: Vanessa / Karthik — can you confirm ownership for the canary gate and training ops? I'll take the production rollout coordination and final MAP assembly.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
